abstract: Comprehensive performance optimization guide for client-side React applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Contains 56 rules across 7 categories, prioritized by impact from critical (eliminating waterfalls, reducing bundle size) to incremental (advanced patterns). Each rule includes detailed explanations, real-world examples comparing incorrect vs. correct implementations, and specific impact metrics to guide automated refactoring and code generation. Server-rendering, RSC, and Next.js-specific guidance is intentionally excluded.
